analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (managed by awang1900) seeks to land veteran volume RB Josh Jacobs from Southside Savages (managed by GGEZGoNext) to strengthen its championship push. Southside Savages is operating under a Retool objective, making 28-year-old Jacobs a prime trade candidate if Southside receives younger, startable assets in return. AVI recommends constructing a package around 24-year-old RB Cam Skattebo and WR Ryan Flournoy. This offer gives Southside a 4-year age reset at RB with high dynasty stability (Skattebo D-AVI: 81.4 vs. Jacobs D-AVI: 80.5) plus immediate FLEX help, while boosting Corgi Loaf's championship starting lineup C-AVI sum by +11.1 points.

submitted.summary: The proposed package sends 24-year-old RB Cam Skattebo and WR Ryan Flournoy to Southside Savages for Josh Jacobs. Corgi Loaf upgrades its active starting lineup by pairing Jacobs with Saquon Barkley and Rhamondre Stevenson (+11.1 C-AVI net gain), advancing its Win Championship goal. Southside Savages advances its Retool objective by securing a 24-year-old starting RB with an elite 81.4 D-AVI profile and adding a reliable FLEX option in Flournoy without collapsing weekly scoring.

recommended.summary: Sending Cam Skattebo and Ryan Flournoy represents the optimal 2-for-1 proposal for Corgi Loaf Baking Co. to acquire Josh Jacobs. It satisfies Southside's Retool objective by delivering a 24-year-old RB replacement and immediate FLEX starter while providing Corgi Loaf the RB1 production needed for a title run.
